raw_sections.experience:
Senior Analyst | Trade Lifecycle & Post-Trade Operations
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Analyst BNY Mellon
Feb 2023 – Jan 2026
Managed end-to-end Trade Lifecycle, Trade Processing and Post-Trade Operations across Equities, Fixed Income and Listed
Derivatives.
Performed Trade Capture, Confirmation, Affirmation, Allocation, Matching and Settlement activities, ensuring timely and accurate
processing.
Managed settlement operations for Equity and Fixed Income securities within defined market cut-offs and settlement timelines.
Performed trade validation, settlement monitoring and Cash & Position Reconciliation; investigated Trade Breaks, Settlement Fails
and operational exceptions.
Monitored pending trades, settlement status and T+1/T+2 processing, driving timely resolution of exceptions and failed settlements.
Coordinated with Brokers, Custodians, Clearing Houses, Banks and internal teams to resolve breaks, escalations and time-sensitive
issues.
Supported Middle Office Operations, SLA Management, Risk Controls, operational reporting and ad-hoc activities.
Business Analyst State Street HCL Service India Pvt. Ltd.
Jun 2022 – Jan 2023
Performed daily Cash Reconciliation across Bank, Custodian and internal feeds, identifying exceptions and breaks.
Investigated Cash & Position Breaks, performed Root Cause Analysis and drove timely resolution within defined SLAs.
Resolved reconciliation discrepancies including missing entries, duplicate postings and incorrect amounts through detailed
transaction validation.
Handled end-to-end settlement activities for Equity and Fixed Income trades, including trade validation, matching, settlement
monitoring, reconciliation and failed-trade resolution.
Investigated Equity and Fixed Income settlement breaks by validating trade details, settlement status and counterparty/custodian
records.
Used TLM for Reconciliation, Break Investigation and Exception Management while ensuring processing accuracy and reconciliation
controls.
Coordinated with Banks, Custodians and internal teams for break resolution, escalation management and timely closure.
